biggest_catch: Zero guaranteed sales: you must apply and be approved to open a shop, create high-quality assets that pass review, set competitive prices, and Creative Market takes a large commission per sale — 2026 reports put it around 50%, and the catalog's '50–70% to sellers' could not be confirmed in current official terms.
catches: Shop applications require a portfolio review; not everyone is accepted.
The per-sale commission is substantial — reported around 50% in 2026 sources; confirm the current rate in the Shop Terms during signup.
No exclusivity requirement (you can sell elsewhere), but competition among shops is intense.
You set your own prices but must factor the commission into them.
Payouts are monthly only (reported around the 10th) — slow cash flow for small sellers.

c1.evidence: Creative Market is a real operating design-asset marketplace (creativemarket.com); its official Shop Terms document the shop-owner model.

c2.evidence: Official Shop Terms: users ('Shop Owners') can open a shop for display, marketing, and sale of design assets; no exclusivity lock-in per Creative Market's own materials.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee to open a shop; costs are the per-sale commission.

c4.evidence: No single official current commission figure could be pinned down — the catalog's '50–70% to sellers' conflicts with 2026 reports of ~50% platform commission — so payout_quote is null; mechanism-only verify.

eligibility: Designers/developers who pass the shop application (portfolio review); earnings require quality assets and actual sales — nothing is guaranteed.
